question: Which document conversion laws should DOCX file import, export and Word paste share, and where must fidelity limits be explicit?
method: best-api-review/history-v2; adversarial reassessment; redesign-from-first-principles; hard-cut public API and trust-boundary audit
trigger: After the initial documents audit, the user requested a final harsh honest check for omissions. This reassessment attacks the prior conclusion and target without authorizing product implementation.
requirements: Keep DOCX file import, DOCX snapshot export and Word clipboard fitting as separate operations; do not absorb media, tables, comments, math, pagination, CSV or authored runtime into a generic documents framework.
A successful file import has one canonical document truth; a failed or partial decode cannot masquerade as an empty successful replacement, and all loss must be actionable.

One file-export operation captures one immutable editor state for every emitted package part, uses an explicit authored projection, preserves installed schema and app-owned presentation, and reports unsupported content.
Private authored metadata may supplement only verified corresponding Word content; changed, corrupt or missing correspondence requires explicit fallback or conflict behavior.

Untrusted DOCX work has bounded input, expansion, part, revision and time policy plus cancellation; no direct OOXML or repaired HTML runtime is accepted without matched correctness and complete-operation cost proof.

Word comments, revisions, package parts, named Plate roots and visible-format properties receive explicit supported, lossy or rejected dispositions rather than inferred fidelity from ZIP validity or a private sidecar.
Public nouns and entrypoints name their actual job: remove file-import RTF, competing nodes/document results and the second authored exporter; rename the clipboard-only DocxPlugin during adoption.
evidenceReuse: Re-read current import/export/paste public types and implementations, EditorDocumentValue, authored snapshot ownership, copied import/export callers, DOCX docs, prior decision and open questions, the completed clipboard ownership decision, and the initial immutable documents record. Reused its matching 135 unique passing tests, two historical bug probes and seven-corpus research only within their recorded limits; no external discovery, upstream execution or product test was repeated. Added current local fingerprints for the editor document contract and final reassessment.
summary: Pursue remains correct, but the initial target was incomplete. Supersede it with one canonical import result, one projection-aware snapshot export, structured diagnostics, bounded untrusted-input policy and an accurately named Word paste adapter. Delete public exportAuthoredToDocx, ImportDocxResult.nodes and file-import rtf; remove unconditional sidecar authority and the duplicate review serializer. Direct OOXML remains the strongest file candidate but is provisional. The earlier blanket recommendation to preserve paste images/table geometry is withdrawn until destination media/table policy proves safe cases.
alternatives: Keep/configure: retain detached import, snapshot export, lazy dependencies, installed schema, remote-image opt-in and app styling; configuration cannot resolve competing result truths, stale native authority, duplicate serializers or missing resource bounds.

Delete/rename/consolidate: selected public direction. Keep three operation boundaries while deleting exportAuthoredToDocx, nodes, file-import rtf, silent warning/blob-only loss and misleading DocxPlugin naming; remove the catalog-only docxExport identity if caller reconciliation confirms no job.
Repair the HTML file path: reuse configured semantic serialization and add explicit Word mappings/diagnostics; valid comparator, but HTML cannot restore package facts discarded before conversion.

Replace file conversion with direct OOXML adapters: strongest candidate for revisions, comment ranges, numbering, relationships, roots and properties; provisional until matched fixtures, complete-operation benchmarks, dependency and adoption proof pass.
Retain an OOXML package beside the canonical document: defer until an actual arbitrary-package editing job defines second-representation identity, lifetime, supported edits and reopen invariants.

Preserve all Word-paste images and table geometry immediately: stop as part of this documents plan; safe payload classes and useful geometry depend on destination media/table policy and size/resource limits.
Add a universal document engine, Office abstraction, public converter registry or shared AST: stop; it merges independent jobs and owners without repeated caller coordination.
proofLimits: No product behavior changed. Reused prior proof only while matching source: 123 package tests plus 12 additional fixture/selected-roundtrip/demo tests, and two bug-observation probes confirming stale sidecar authority and mixed export captures. No native Word/LibreOffice, browser paste, current packed install, full slow suite, performance, decompression-limit, cancellation, comment-range, named-root, cross-part revision or arbitrary lossless-roundtrip proof. No security exploit is claimed. The seven-corpus/67-file comparison is inherited from the previous immutable record; no upstream source or tests were refreshed in this reassessment. Exact result/error/limit/comment types and HTML-versus-OOXML runtime remain for Task design and prototype.
